verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a business phone and communications platform, since on-premise PBX deployments exist in this category, so the axis applies. The evidence presents RingCentral only as a cloud service, framed as replacing on-premise PBX systems. Nothing in the pack documents a self-hostable or on-premise deployment of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
